title: Materialized-copy conflict outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give when a materialized copy changed both locally and upstream since it was fetched. Never a merge rule: which side wins depends on why the local edit was made.

source.note: bean bvuk; the owner's own answer set and design, 2026-09-23

codes.label: The remote wins
codes.definition: Take the upstream version; the local copy is re-materialized from it (Task_Apply).

codes.label: The local edit wins
codes.definition: Keep the local edit AND re-pin, so the same settled question stops being asked on every refresh (Task_KeepLocal).

codes.label: Neither whole — reconcile
codes.definition: Reconcile the two by hand, then apply, so the five import gates see the hand-made artefact rather than being told about it (Task_Reconcile).

codes.label: Not decidable today
codes.definition: Decide nothing and do NOT re-pin — the only thing separating it from local. The conflict is recorded, because a deferral nobody wrote down is indistinguishable from a refresh that silently did nothing (Task_RecordConflict).
